name: Greta Mosshoof
summary: Greta Mosshoof is a tauren druid allied with the Emerald Circle at the Emerald Sanctuary in southern Felwood. Alongside night elves and fellow guardians of nature, she investigates the foul taint creeping across the ancient forest and directs scouts into the Shadow Council stronghold of Jaedenar.

sections.title: Guardian of the Forest
sections.body: Stationed at the Emerald Sanctuary on the southern boundary of Felwood, Greta Mosshoof works alongside the Emerald Circle to combat the pervasive corruption consuming the ancient woods. Rather than surrendering the blighted lands to the demonic taint left in the wake of the Third War, she coordinates efforts to understand and push back the spreading rot. Her investigations zero in on the poisoned waters of Felwood and the foul cultists burrowed within Jaedenar.

sections.title: Striking at the Shadow Council
sections.body: Greta Mosshoof is instrumental in uncovering the machinations of the Shadow Council operating from the depths of Jaedenar. Recognizing that the corrupted springs and foul wards in the chasm directly feed the sickness choking the land, she enlists travelers to sample the tainted waters, seek the assistance of shamans like Islen Waterseer on the distant coast, and dismantle the ritual braziers that protect the demonic cabal from intrusion.

faq.answer: Greta Mosshoof is a tauren member of the Emerald Circle stationed at the Emerald Sanctuary in Felwood. She aids travelers and druids in investigating and undoing the demonic blight poisoning the forest.

faq.q: What faction does Greta Mosshoof belong to?
aliases: is greta mosshoof horde or alliance
faq.answer: Greta Mosshoof is a member of the Emerald Circle, a neutral organization dedicated to healing nature. As such, she offers guidance and quests to both Alliance and Horde adventurers.

faq.q: Why is Greta sending adventurers into Jaedenar?
faq.answer: Jaedenar is the stronghold of the Shadow Council in Felwood, responsible for pumping demonic bile into the land's waterways and maintaining wards that shelter demons. Greta directs strikes against Jaedenar to dismantle their rituals and purify the blighted springs.

faq.q: What is Greta Mosshoof's connection to Islen Waterseer?
faq.answer: Greta is friends with Islen Waterseer, a wise shaman residing along the coast of the Barrens. When Greta discovers corrupt water samples from Felwood, she directs adventurers to seek Islen's spiritual mastery to purify the fluid so it can cleanse the poisoned springs.

angles.text: For druids working to purge the scars of the Burning Legion, Greta Mosshoof represents the cooperative spirit of the Cenarion circle, setting aside faction ties to restore Kalimdor's wilderness.
Greta demonstrates the dedication of the tauren to healing the Earth Mother's wounds, even far to the north in lands once guarded solely by the night elves.
